'''Valorn Skez''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]], [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], and a vaccine for the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] aboard the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Carrick Station]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
